nflxPolicy.policy_label: Default June 30, 2026 allocation from filed 10-Q claims; judgment inputs from the published restricted illustration
nflxPolicy.basis: Filed June 30, 2026 10-Q: cash $9,099.232m + short-term investments $28.678m, senior-note face principal $14,372m (derivatives excluded), separate financing interest-rate derivative net liability $13.574m, 4,163.939676m common shares, 123.891603m vested options at $39.21 weighted strike, 2.012512m unvested RSU/PSU units taken at their reported count (1x). Income-tax reserve $566m is the latest filed gross unrecognized tax benefit (FY2025 10-K; the June 10-Q discloses none). Additional Brazil exposure beyond the $729m paid in H1 is assumed zero; no further amount is disclosed. Operating cash reserve $3,000m, other claims $250m, financing FX reserve $100m, option life 4.5y / volatility 35% / risk-free 4%, existing-award expense $25m/$25m/$10m to Dec 2028, retained 1.1% future-grant and 20% other cash costs, and H2 2026 cash settlement of all separate claims ($929.574m) are the published restricted illustration's analyst choices. Not a current price target.

fields.locator: 10-Q Jun 30 2026, Note 7 Debt (HTML table 25), aggregate senior-note principal, rounded USD m
fields.note_en: Face principal of senior notes; engine requires the face-principal convention excluding financing derivatives.
fields.note_zh: 优先票据面值本金；引擎要求采用不含融资衍生工具的面值口径。

fields.note_en: Debt valued at filed face principal, not fair value ($14,605m) or carrying value ($14,309.306m).
fields.note_zh: 债务按申报面值计量，而非公允价值（14,605）或账面价值（14,309.306）。

fields.locator: 10-Q Jun 30 2026, Note 8 Derivatives (HTML table 27): interest-rate derivative liabilities 14.934 less assets 0.236+1.124
fields.note_en: Reported net liability of the fair-value interest-rate hedges on the notes, reserved separately from face debt.
fields.note_zh: 票据利率公允价值套期的申报净负债，与面值债务分开预留。

fields.note_en: Reported unvested RSU/PSU count used as-is (1x); the published illustration uses a 2x stress.
fields.note_zh: 直接采用申报的未归属 RSU/PSU 数量（1 倍）；已发布示例使用 2 倍压力情景。

fields.locator: 10-K Dec 31 2025, Note 11 Income Taxes, gross unrecognized tax benefits $566m
fields.note_en: Latest filed gross unrecognized tax benefit; the June 10-Q gives no updated amount, so this Dec 2025 figure is a stale proxy used by the illustration.
fields.note_zh: 最近一次申报的未确认税收利益总额；六月 10-Q 未更新该数，故沿用示例所用的 2025 年 12 月旧数作为代理。

fields.locator: 10-Q Jun 30 2026, MD&A Liquidity: $729m Brazil non-income-tax assessment payments already made in H1
fields.note_en: The $729m is already out of June cash; the 10-Q quantifies no further Brazil exposure. Zero is an assumption, not verified absence (same as illustration).
fields.note_zh: 729 百万美元已从六月现金中支付；10-Q 未量化其他巴西风险。零为假设，并非证实不存在（与示例相同）。

fields.note_en: Operating liquidity kept back from the $9,127.91m June cash and investments; analyst judgment, no filed figure.
fields.note_zh: 从六月 9,127.91 百万美元现金及投资中保留的经营流动性；属分析判断，无申报数字。

fields.locator: 10-Q Jun 30 2026, Note 9 Commitments and Contingencies (no accrued amount for litigation/indemnification)
fields.note_en: Allowance for unaccrued litigation and indemnification claims, which the filing does not quantify.
fields.note_zh: 为申报未量化、未计提的诉讼及赔偿请求权预留。

fields.locator: 10-Q Jun 30 2026, Note 8: financing FX hedge notional $2,934.991m; net fair value not separately disclosed
fields.note_en: Financing FX hedge net fair value is not disclosed separately from operating hedges; illustration reserve used.
fields.note_zh: 融资外汇套期的净公允价值未与经营套期分开披露；沿用示例预留。

fields.locator: 10-K Dec 31 2025 Stock Option Activity: weighted remaining term 4.79 years (June 10-Q gives none)
fields.note_en: June remaining option life is not filed; illustration value, close to the Dec 2025 filed 4.79 years less six months.
fields.note_zh: 六月期权剩余期限未申报；采用示例值，接近 2025 年 12 月申报的 4.79 年减半年。

fields.note_en: Black-Scholes volatility for the vested option block; analyst judgment.
fields.note_zh: 已归属期权组合的 Black-Scholes 波动率；属分析判断。

fields.note_en: Risk-free rate for the option proxy; analyst judgment.
fields.note_zh: 期权代理估值的无风险利率；属分析判断。

fields.locator: 10-K Dec 31 2025: $47m unrecognized RSU/PSU cost over 1.53 years; 10-Q Jun 30 2026: 1,245,383 units granted at $82.91
fields.note_en: Remaining expense of existing awards embedded in EBIT; June balance not filed. Within the $150.25m source-context envelope.
fields.note_zh: 现有奖励已含在 EBIT 中的剩余费用；六月余额未申报。处于 150.25 百万美元来源区间之内。

fields.note_en: $25m H2 2026, $25m 2027, $10m 2028; reconciles exactly to the $60m total.
fields.note_zh: 2026 下半年 25、2027 年 25、2028 年 10 百万美元；与 60 百万美元合计完全一致。

fields.note_en: Last date existing-award expense is recognized; must be no later than June 30, 2029.
fields.note_zh: 现有奖励费用的最晚确认日；不得晚于 2029 年 6 月 30 日。

fields.note_en: 1.1% of revenue kept in EBIT for future grants, above the filed FY2025 SBC/revenue floor.
fields.note_zh: 未来授予薪酬按收入的 1.1% 保留在 EBIT 中，高于 2025 财年申报的 SBC/收入下限。

fields.note_en: 20% of revenue of other cash costs already in EBIT; capacity check only, not subtracted again.
fields.note_zh: EBIT 中已含的其他现金成本按收入 20% 计；仅用于容量检查，不重复扣除。

fields.note_en: All separate claim reserves are paid in H2 2026 (hedges assumed closed July 1); schedule PV cannot exceed the reserves.
fields.note_zh: 全部单独请求权预留在 2026 下半年支付（套期假设 7 月 1 日平仓）；计划现值不超过预留。

fields.note_en: All eight convention acknowledgements accepted, as in the site template and illustration.
fields.note_zh: 与站点模板及示例相同，接受全部八项口径确认。

summary_en: June 30, 2026 allocation using the filed 10-Q cash, $14,372m face debt, rate-hedge liability, shares, options and RSU/PSU count; reserves, option inputs and award-expense schedule follow the published restricted illustration. Not a current price target.
summary_zh: 2026 年 6 月 30 日分配：采用 10-Q 申报的现金、14,372 百万美元面值债务、利率套期负债、股数、期权及 RSU/PSU 数量；各项预留、期权参数和奖励费用计划沿用已发布的受限示例。并非当前目标价。
